hypothesis: Weekly scheduling and an explicit relative-score switching hurdle may reduce costly coin churn;skipping the most recent week tests whether short-horizon reversal contaminates relative formation. Both mechanisms are hypotheses,not evidence imported from equity papers.

time_boundaries.state: One cold cash start per configuration at OOS start,no imported spring-summer positions,no interfold resets;carry actual cash,units and desired through the missing winter period.

data.format: Archived Binance spot 1m OHLCV; daily closes and quote ADV are aggregated from fully closed UTC days.

execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC.

costs.impact_inputs: Previous20 completed UTC day quote ADV and sample stdev20 log daily returns. Buy cash before costs is conservative notional upper bound; sell uses units*reference. Decimal sqrt of budget/ADV, sigma/ADV derived from existing lagged daily function.

rules.signal: At completed UTC day j=i-1,absoluteROC_a=C_a[j]/C_a[j-L]-1;rankROC_a=C_a[j-S]/C_a[j-S-L]-1. Only assets with current absoluteROC>0 eligible. Select highest rankROC among eligible;BTC priority on exact tie.
rules.schedule: Only Mondays at next00:01UTC;no initial off-schedule buy. Other days keep actual holding,do not exit on new signals. Calendar from UTC date,not fold offsets.
rules.switching: If incumbent is eligible,retain it unless another eligible asset rankROC strictly exceeds incumbent rankROC by G. If incumbent ineligible,select best eligible without switching hurdle,or cash if none. Equality retains incumbent. S=0 is contemporaneous rank;S=7 skips exactly seven completed days in ranking,while cash gate always uses current absoluteROC.
rules.execution: On target change,sell all held coin before buying target at same declared next00:01 nativeDecimalOPEN. Both real legs charged separately;rejected sale prevents purchase. Quantity-rounding residue remains shared cash. No trade if target stays same.
rules.allocation: One shared2000USDT spot cash account;at most one BTC or ETH holding with raw target exposure1,other0. No75/25normalization,fixed-sleeve NAV sum,cashyield,borrowing,leverage,short or external transfers. Original frozen75/25SMA account unchanged.
rules.state: One cold cash start;carry actual cash,held asset,units across all12folds. No independent old component NAV can represent stateful shared-cash rotations,so actual new fill paths required.

sensitivity: Each S=0/7 direction has full L×G3x3;inclusive adjacent-index rectangular neighborhoods separately. All18configs,54costs,648folds disclosed;skip-pair contrasts descriptive,no OOS selection.
validation: 365day initial historical context plus3day gap;12continuous30dayfolds,no fitting or future labels,purgeNA. At each fold context rolls causally. Reused development history,not untouched final test;no DSR/PBO or live profit claim.

NAV_axis.definition: Initial cash;each day predecisionnativeOPEN,post-saleOPEN,post-purchaseOPEN slots including duplicates when unused,then1440originalFloat64closedminute marks;at end preterminalOPEN then costed liquidation. This preserves both rotation-leg marks and gap risks.

read_only_context.scope: Old daily rotation rejected;not rerun or recast as new evidence. Same-capital360dayhold references read-only,with their original filter/metric conventions disclosed.

sources.scope: Author equity research excludes recent month;our seven-daycrypto skip and weekly hysteresis are separately tested hypotheses,not paper replication.
Official indexed abstract supports crypto momentum motivation only;direct page403,fulltextnotread.
Official current filter definitions;actualhistoricalexecution uses frozenOct1snapshot proxy.

limits: Only two liquid spot assets and reused history;no independent holdout.
Weekly risk exits wait until Monday;intraweek losses intentionally retained,no implicit stop.
